title: The Importance of Leadership Skills , Culture Awareness & Emotional Intelligence

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们除了用时间换取金钱之外还能赚钱，会怎么样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特伦特博士，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动和循环收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个好消息要宣布。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many program is now open for enrollment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特的“一对多”项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships, and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，比如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己在2022年完成了这个项目，此后也支持了两批心理学家走过他们的旅程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的专属链接加入，你将获得苏菲的额外福利以及我提供的专属支持套餐，无需额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四场小组智囊团交流、大师班、个性化指导、一份福特南·梅森的礼品，以及限时的一对一教练辅导福利。

sentences.en: Enrollment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日星期一晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过简介中链接我的福利页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的福利。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。

sentences.en: If you're looking to become a psychologist, your guys decide to be on your way to the Aspiring Psychologist Podcast with Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 如果你想成为一名心理学家，你们决定踏上《有抱负的心理学家播客》的旅程，主持人是玛丽安·特伦特博士。

sentences.en: Welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist PodcaSt.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《有抱负的心理学家播客》。

sentences.en: It is an absolute pleasure to have you here.
sentences.zh: 非常高兴你能来到这里。

sentences.en: And thank you as ever for listening or watching as you may be watching this on YouTube.
sentences.zh: 一如既往地感谢你们的收听或观看，因为你们也可能在YouTube上观看本期节目。

sentences.en: Today's episode came about from a conversation with a LinkedIn connection because I love networking with people.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目源于与一位领英好友的对话，因为我喜欢与人建立社交网络。

sentences.en: And we were talking about improving access in psychology.
sentences.zh: 当时我们在讨论如何改善心理学服务的可及性。

sentences.en: And that's where the idea for this podcast episode came about today.
sentences.zh: 这就是今天这期播客节目灵感的来源。

sentences.en: I am joined by a lovely man called Carl, who is going to be talking us through leadership, change, inclusion, all of those good things.
sentences.zh: 今天和我在一起的是一位可爱的人，名叫卡尔，他将为我们讲解领导力、变革、包容性以及所有这些美好的事物。

sentences.en: Hope you will find it so useful.
sentences.zh: 希望你会发现这非常有用。

sentences.en: And I will look forward to catching you on the other side.
sentences.zh: 我期待在节目后半部分与你相见。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to today's episode of the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎收听今天的播客节目。

sentences.en: I am joined today by my lovely guest, Carl Mahay.
sentences.zh: 今天和我在一起的是我可爱的嘉宾，卡尔·马海。

sentences.en: Carl, thank you for joining us.
sentences.zh: 卡尔，谢谢你加入我们。

sentences.en: No, thank you for having me.
sentences.zh: 不，谢谢你邀请我。

sentences.en: It's an absolute pleasure.
sentences.zh: 非常荣幸。

sentences.en: Lovely.
sentences.zh: 太好了。

sentences.en: So could you tell the audience a little bit about you and your background, if that's OK?
sentences.zh: 那么，如果不介意的话，能向观众简单介绍一下你自己和你的背景吗？

sentences.en: Yes, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 好的，没问题。

sentences.en: So I spent 32 years in the police service from the age of 16.
sentences.zh: 我在警察部门度过了32年，从16岁开始。

sentences.en: Yes, I was a 16, spotty-faced kid when I joined the police service back in January 1983.
sentences.zh: 是的，早在1983年1月我加入警察部门时，我还是一个16岁满脸青春痘的孩子。

sentences.en: It's all I ever wanted to do from the age of 10.
sentences.zh: 从10岁起，这就是我唯一想做的事。

sentences.en: It was like my dream.
sentences.zh: 这就像是我的梦想。

sentences.en: And back in those days, you used to have full-time police cadets.
sentences.zh: 在那个年代，你们过去常常有全职的警察学员。

sentences.en: And I applied to 26 police forces.
sentences.zh: 我向26个警察部队递交了申请。

sentences.en: And I just committed to whichever one would say yes to me firSt.
sentences.zh: 我只是铁了心，无论哪一个先对我说“yes”，我就加入哪一个。

sentences.en: I just joined then.
sentences.zh: 我当时就加入了。

sentences.en: It happened to be in Derbyshire.
sentences.zh: 结果是在德比郡。

sentences.en: So I up six from my concrete jungle in Wolverhampton and landed in the beautiful green field of
sentences.zh: 所以我打包离开了我在伍尔弗汉普顿的钢筋水泥森林，来到了美丽的绿野

sentences.en: Derbyshire and been here ever since.
sentences.zh: 德比郡，并且从那以后一直留在这里。

sentences.en: Amazing.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: Oh, I feel like there's lots and lots of questions I can ask you about mental health in policing and mental health in the people you look after in policing.
sentences.zh: 哦，我觉得我可以问你很多很多关于警务中的心理健康，以及你在警务中照顾的人的心理健康的问题。

sentences.en: But that's probably a separate issue.
sentences.zh: 但这可能是一个独立的话题。

sentences.en: So how did you get from being working in the police field to where you are now?
sentences.zh: 那么，你是如何从警务领域走到现在的职位的？

sentences.en: Well, my journey in the police service was quite an interesting one, given the kind of job that we were doing, but also my own personal journey.
sentences.zh: 嗯，考虑到我们所做的工作性质，我在警察部门的经历相当有趣，这也是我个人心路历程的一部分。

sentences.en: When I joined the police service, I was literally a brown speck in a sea of white.
sentences.zh: 自我加入警察部门以来，我简直就是白人群体中的一个小黑点。

sentences.en: Two-thirds of my service was spent at leadership levels.
sentences.zh: 我的三分之二的警察生涯都是在领导岗位上度过的。

sentences.en: Towards the end, my last third in the police service, in my last eight, nine years, I was what they call a gold commander, sitting at superintendent, chief superintendent level.
sentences.zh: 临近尾声，在我警察生涯的最后三分之一，也就是最后八、九年里，我担任所谓的金色指挥官（Gold Commander），处于总警司、高级总警司级别。

sentences.en: We're a gold commander for all major incidents, critical incidents.
sentences.zh: 我们是所有重大事件、危机事件的金色指挥官。

sentences.en: I was the person, I guess, where all the problems would be sitting on my shoulders.
sentences.zh: 我想我就是那种所有问题都压在肩膀上的人。

sentences.en: If something went wrong, I'd be responsible for that.
sentences.zh: 如果出了什么问题，我将为此负责。

sentences.en: So I've been responsible for major public disorder issues, firearms incidents, bomb hoaxes, bomb threats, major football matches and things of that nature, as well as managing my
sentences.zh: 所以我曾负责重大公共骚乱事件、枪支事件、诈弹恶作剧、炸弹威胁、重大足球比赛以及类似性质的事情，同时还要管理我

sentences.en: day-to-day department of, you know, up to 400 people at a time.
sentences.zh: 日常的部门，你知道，每次多达400人。

sentences.en: And what I learned in the police service was this, how powerful good leadership can be and how it can impact and empower people, but also how it can destroy people's lives.
sentences.zh: 我在警察部门学到的是：良好的领导力可以多么强大，它如何能影响和赋能人们，但它也能如何摧毁人们的生活。

sentences.en: One of the first things I used to say to any leadership team that I would take over in a new department is that we need to be mindful of the language that comes out of our mouths,
sentences.zh: 我接手一个新部门时，对任何领导团队说的第一件事就是，我们需要注意我们口中说出的语言，

sentences.en: because it can either empower people, inspire people and help people move forward, or it
sentences.zh: 因为它们要么可以赋予人们力量、激励人们并帮助人们前进，要么就会

sentences.en: can destroy people's lives and they will take it away home with them and they'll infect their families and their friends with how we treat them.
sentences.zh: 摧毁人们的生活，他们会把它带回家，并用我们对待他们的方试去“传染”他们的家人和朋友。

sentences.en: So I realized for me that people in leadership are, the concept of people is very, very important.
sentences.zh: 所以我意识到，对领导者来说，人的概念非常非常重要。

sentences.en: And when I left the police service, I wanted to help other organizations create those kind of cultures and those conversations where there was trust throughout the organization,
sentences.zh: 当我离开警察部门时，我想帮助其他组织建立那种文化和对话，让整个组织内部充满信任，

sentences.en: greater performance in the organization.
sentences.zh: 提高组织的绩效。

sentences.en: As a result, the people became much more emotional intelligence and stop using that as a glib phrase to truly understand what emotional intelligence in practice looks like.
sentences.zh: 因此，人们变得更有情商，不再把这当作一句油腔滑调的口号，而是真正理解情商在实践中究竟是什么样子的。

sentences.en: And now I have the great honor, pleasure of teaching other people exactly that.
sentences.zh: 现在，我有幸向其他人准确地传授这些。

sentences.en: I work with leaders on a one-to-one coaching basis.
sentences.zh: 我以一对一辅导的方式与领导者合作。

sentences.en: I design programs for universities, for organizations, and I help organizations change their culture.
sentences.zh: 我为大学、组织设计课程，并帮助组织改变他们的文化。

sentences.en: And I'm sort of in my sweet spot, I guess.
sentences.zh: 我想我可以说正处于我的最佳状态（sweet spot）。

sentences.en: It found you, you know, you just, you ended up where you needed to be.
sentences.zh: 它找到了你，你知道的，你最终来到了你需要去的地方。

sentences.en: Tell us a little bit about how you've been working alongside doctoral programs lately, Carl.
sentences.zh: 卡尔，请跟我们谈谈你最近是如何与博士项目合作的。

sentences.en: Well, I mean, this came sort of out of the blue for me, really.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我的意思是，这对我来说有点始料未及。

sentences.en: And I'll have to admit to some imposter syndrome kicking in for me, because essentially I was being asked to teach psychology to psychologists.
sentences.zh: 我得承认，我产生了一些“冒名顶替综合征”，因为本质上我被要求向心理学家教心理学。

sentences.en: And there was this internal conversation inside myself as to whether I could actually do that.
sentences.zh: 我内心在进行自我对话，怀疑自己是否真的能做到这一点。

sentences.en: But the way it happened was this.
sentences.zh: 但事情的经过是这样的。

sentences.en: I'd been working for a number of universities who had asked me to come in to design programs
sentences.zh: 我曾为多所大学工作过，他们邀请我来为他们设计课程

sentences.en: for them and then deliver those programs to help those underrepresented groups of members of staff
sentences.zh: 然后讲授这些课程，以帮助那些代表性不足的员工群体

sentences.en: to aspire towards more senior levels in the organizations to increase the representation.
sentences.zh: 立志在组织中担任更高层级的职位，以提高代表性。

sentences.en: So I designed for this particular university, which was University of Lincoln, I designed a program
sentences.zh: 所以我为这所特定的大学，即林肯大学，设计了一个项目

sentences.en: which was a very pragmatic program based upon the 26 competency areas that we talk about
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常务实的课程，基于我们在美国社会情商研究所讨论的26个胜任力领域

sentences.en: in social emotional intelligence as a member of the Institute of Social Emotional Intelligence over in America.
sentences.zh: 作为美国社会情商研究所的成员，我们讨论了这些领域。

sentences.en: I drilled down deep into these 26 competency areas and pulled out some pragmatic tools, if you like, and techniques, leadership techniques that I could teach people.
sentences.zh: 我深入钻研这26个胜任力领域，提炼出了一些务实的工具（如果你愿意这么叫的话）和技术，我可以教给人们的领导力技术。

sentences.en: And for me, any program that I design has to have some pragmatism involved within there.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，我设计的任何课程都必须包含一些务实精神。

sentences.en: People need to be able to grab hold of something and then be able to apply that in their lives.
sentences.zh: 人们需要能够掌握某些东西，然后能够将其应用到他们的生活中。

sentences.en: So we brought this program together for the underrepresented groups in this university and we saw some incredible success as a result of it.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们为这所大学中代表性不足的群体汇集了这个课程，结果我们看到了令人难以置信的成功。

sentences.en: It was a six-module program spread over about three months.
sentences.zh: 这是一个为期三个月的六模块课程。

sentences.en: And we saw people being promoted and applying for much more senior positions and that the university itself was seeing this representation, this diverse representation
sentences.zh: 我们看到人们得到晋升，并申请更高的高级职位，而且大学本身也看到了他们一直渴望的这种代表性、这种多元化的代表性。

sentences.en: that they had aspired to.
sentences.zh: 他们所渴望的。

sentences.en: So a few months later, I got approached by the Trent doctoral program, which I think was a collaboration with the schools of psychology from Lincoln
sentences.zh: 因此，几个月后，特伦特博士项目找到了我，我想这是林肯大学心理学学院与诺丁汉大学心理学学院的合作项目。

sentences.en: and from University of Nottingham.
sentences.zh: 与诺丁汉大学。

sentences.en: And they also said, look, we've got some underrepresentation as well.
sentences.zh: 他们也说，看，我们也有代表性不足的问题。

sentences.en: So could you run a program, the same program, for our postgraduates to help them to aspire towards the doctoral program?
sentences.zh: 所以你能为我们的研究生开设一个项目，同样的课程，来帮助他们立志攻读博士学位吗？

sentences.en: So we ran the same program with two cohorts of assistant psychologists.
sentences.zh: 于是我们为两批助理心理学家开设了相同的课程。

sentences.en: And what we saw at the end of it all was I think we had four or five people who were successful in applying for the doctoral program.
sentences.zh: 这一切结束时，我们看到的是，我想我们有四五个人成功申请了博士项目。

sentences.en: And those that weren't successful or those that chose not to apply actually went on to see some level of success in the work that they were doing.
sentences.zh: 而那些没有成功的人，或者选择不申请的人，实际上在他们所做的工作中取得了一定程度的成功。

sentences.en: So we had a number of people being promoted and we had one in particular who reached out to me and said, hey, I went for a job interview at a much more senior level
sentences.zh: 所以我们有很多人得到了晋升，特别是有一个人联系我说，嘿，我去一个更高层级的职位面试了

sentences.en: and I used all the techniques that we'd learned on the program.
sentences.zh: 我用了我们在课程中学到的所有技巧。

sentences.en: But I got told I was unsuccessful.
sentences.zh: 但我被告知我没有成功。

sentences.en: But the reason I was unsuccessful was apparently because I was too good.
sentences.zh: 但我没有成功的原因显然是因为我太优秀了。

sentences.en: And instead, I was offered the job of the manager for the post that I'd applied for.
sentences.zh: 相反，我被提供我所申请的那个职位的经理工作。

sentences.en: So she went off and got a bit of a bonus job, I guess.
sentences.zh: 所以她去得到了一份额外的奖励工作，我想。

sentences.en: That's a great result.
sentences.zh: 这是一个极好的结果。

sentences.en: We must have felt absolutely thrilled with that.
sentences.zh: 你对此一定感到非常兴奋。

sentences.en: And I guess my own experience with the aspiring psychologist membership is just it's incredible when you get to follow stories.
sentences.zh: 我想我自己在有抱负的心理学家会员中的经历也是如此，当你能关注这些故事时，这真是不可思议。

sentences.en: And when you see your work make a real difference to real people's lives, it's really, really it's just, you know, the sort of thing.
sentences.zh: 当你看到你的工作给真实人们的生活带来真正的改变时，这真的很真实，真的是……你知道的，就是那种感觉。

sentences.en: And I guess you'll have those memories from the police as well, you know, throughout your career when you feel like you've been able to make a difference.
sentences.zh: 我想你的警察生涯中也会有这些记忆，你知道，在你的整个职业生涯中，当你觉得自己能够发挥作用时。

sentences.en: It's just like a golden nugget that you get to keep forever.
sentences.zh: 这就像是一块你可以永远珍藏的金矿石。

sentences.en: And it's really lovely.
sentences.zh: 这真的很美好。

sentences.en: No, there's no substitute for that.
sentences.zh: 不，没有什么可以替代这一点。

sentences.en: And stories are the things that keep memories alive for us.
sentences.zh: 故事是为我们保持记忆鲜活的东西。

sentences.en: You know, when we put a memory in the context of a story for me, I think it brings it alive.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当我们把记忆置于一个故事的语境中时，我认为它会让记忆变得生动。

sentences.en: So in much of the programs that I deliver, stories sit at the very, very heart.
sentences.zh: 因此，在我所讲授的许多课程中，故事都处于最核心的地位。

sentences.en: And one of the modules on the program that I delivered was based around public speaking.
sentences.zh: 我讲授的课程中的一个模块是以公众演讲为基础的。

sentences.en: I mean, I teach public speaking.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我教公众演讲。

sentences.en: So on this particular module, all of the candidates, all the delegates had a very intense day of learning how to do public speaking.
sentences.zh: 所以在这一特定的模块中，所有的候选人、所有的代表都度过了非常紧张的一天，学习如何进行公众演讲。

sentences.en: And one of the elements was how do you structure a story?
sentences.zh: 其中一个要素是如何构建一个故事？

sentences.en: And for me, a story has to have a beginning, a middle and an end.
sentences.zh: 对劳说，一个故事必须有开头、中间和结尾。

sentences.en: The beginning is really setting the scene and talking about the adversary, the act two, if you like, part two of the story is really about the journey that you undertake.
sentences.zh: 开头真的是设定场景并讨论对手，第二幕，如果你愿意的话，故事的第二部分其实是关于你所经历的旅程。

sentences.en: You know, the ups and downs, if you think of the Hobbit and all of the things that the Hobbit had to do in the Lord of the Rings.
sentences.zh: 你知道，起起伏伏，如果你想想《霍比特人》以及霍比特人在《指环王》中必须做所有的事情。

sentences.en: And then finally, it's that realisation and implementing this newfound knowledge and wisdom.
sentences.zh: 最后，是那种顿悟，以及将这些新获得的知识和智慧付诸实践。

sentences.en: And then what happened as a result of that?
sentences.zh: 然后作为结果发生了什么？

sentences.en: So those are the three acts for storytelling.
sentences.zh: 这就是讲故事的三幕。

sentences.en: And I think storytelling is critical to any learning that we ever undertake in our lives.
sentences.zh: 我认为讲故事对于我们在生活中进行的任何学习都至关重要。

sentences.en: I love that.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这样。

sentences.en: I love that.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这样。

sentences.en: And as you're talking, I was just thinking, maybe Carl can get me to stop saying um.
sentences.zh: 当你说话时，我一直在想，也许卡尔能让我停止说“嗯”。

sentences.en: Um, here's the thing, Marion, I still say um and ah, and I purposely now do it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，事情是这样的，玛丽安，我仍然会说“嗯”和“啊”，我现在是有意这样做的。

sentences.en: And the reason I just did it there.
sentences.zh: 我刚才那样做也是出于这个原因。

sentences.en: And the reason why I do it is because it's real.
sentences.zh: 我这样做的原因是因为这是真实的。

sentences.en: You know, when we're having a conversation, we um and ah, we don't think twice of it.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当我们进行对话时，我们会“嗯”会“啊”，我们对此并不介意。

sentences.en: So why should we think about it when we're in front of a camera or on a stage?
sentences.zh: 那为什么当我们在镜头前或舞台上时，我们要去考虑它呢？

sentences.en: I have delivered, I would say, in the region of 200 keynote presentations in the last two years of lockdown.
sentences.zh: 可以说，在封锁的过去两年里，我发表了大约200场主题演讲。

sentences.en: And I guess I will have ummed and ah'd in every single one.
sentences.zh: 我想我在每一次演讲中都会“嗯”和“啊”。

sentences.en: You know, I've done television interviews.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我做过电视采访。

sentences.en: I've spoken on stages.
sentences.zh: 我在舞台上讲过话。

sentences.en: At one point, I think I spoke to a thousand people.
sentences.zh: 有一段时间，我想我对一千人讲过话。

sentences.en: And I um and ah'd because I think it's natural.
sentences.zh: 我“嗯”了也“啊”了，因为我认为这很自然。

sentences.en: And people are drawn.
sentences.zh: 人们会被吸引。

sentences.en: People are drawn to people who come across as being really natural and authentic.
sentences.zh: 人们会被那些表现得非常自然和真实的人所吸引。

sentences.en: And I think that's the new superpower in this changing world in which we exist that people are looking for.
sentences.zh: 我认为这是我们所处的不断变化的世界中的新超能力，也是人们正在寻找的。

sentences.en: People are drawn to authenticity.
sentences.zh: 人们被真实性所吸引。

sentences.en: So why be that, you know, the absolutely polished individual when you can be real?
sentences.zh: 所以，当你能做真实的人时，为什么要当那个绝对完美雕琢的个人呢？

sentences.en: So I love that.
sentences.zh: 所以我很喜欢这样。

sentences.en: We're embracing my uMs.
sentences.zh: 我们在拥抱我的“嗯”。

sentences.en: When I listen, I think it's the trauma episode of this podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 当我听的时候，我认为这是本播客的创伤主题集。

sentences.en: I was obviously wanting to make sure I handled it really sensitively.
sentences.zh: 我显然想确保我非常敏感地处理它。

sentences.en: So I was really slowing it down.
sentences.zh: 所以我真的把它放慢了。

sentences.en: And honestly, I feel like I need to do like an um bop, like bingo, where people listen to it, count the uMs.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我觉得我需要做一个像“嗯”的流行音乐，比如宾果游戏，人们听它，数“嗯”的次数。

sentences.en: And then there's a prize for whoever gets the right number, because there are lots of uMs.
sentences.zh: 然后猜对数字的人会得到奖品，因为有很多“嗯”。

sentences.en: But it is a great episode as well.
sentences.zh: 但这也是一集很棒的节目。

sentences.en: So I will embrace the uMs.
sentences.zh: 所以我将拥抱这些“嗯”。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: I mean, one way of reducing the number of ums, I mean, I would always say don't eliminate them.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，减少“嗯”的数量的一个方法，我的意思是，我总是说不要消灭它们。

sentences.en: That's my personal take on it.
sentences.zh: 这就是我个人的看法。

sentences.en: But you can reduce them just simply by slowing down.
sentences.zh: 但只要你放慢语速，就能大大减少这些口头禅。

sentences.en: So the reason why we um and are is to give ourselves thinking time and space, right?
sentences.zh: 所以我们说“嗯”和“啊”的原因，是为了给自己思考的时间和空间，对吧？

sentences.en: So rather than um and are, just pause.
sentences.zh: 所以与其说“嗯”和“啊”，不如直接停顿。

sentences.en: Just pause and allow yourself time to think.
sentences.zh: 只要停顿一下，给自己留出思考的时间。

sentences.en: And actually, when it comes out in the final recording, it doesn't sound anywhere near as bad as you think it is in the moment of taking that pause.
sentences.zh: 事实上，当它出现在最终的录音里时，听起来远没有你在进行那次停顿时想象的那么糟糕。

sentences.en: So we're so scared of pausing.
sentences.zh: 所以我们太害怕停顿了。

sentences.en: We want to fill every single gap with some kind of noise.
sentences.zh: 我们想用某种声音填满每一个空白。

sentences.en: But actually, when you take that pause and you listen back, you think, wow, that sounds pretty good.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，当你稍作停顿并回听时，你会觉得，哇，听起来真不错。

sentences.en: So all the best interviews, all the best presenters in the world know how to take a pause.
sentences.zh: 所以世界上所有最棒的采访者、所有最棒的主持人都知道如何停顿。

sentences.en: Good.
sentences.zh: 很好。

sentences.en: I will bear that in mind.
sentences.zh: 我会记住这一点的。

sentences.en: I don't notice my ums at the time that I do them.
sentences.zh: 我在说的时候并没有注意到自己用了“嗯”。

sentences.en: I think it is anyone I'm editing back.
sentences.zh: 我想只有当我回听剪辑时才会发现。

sentences.en: You know, when you're editing the podcast, you're like, oh, there's a lot of ums there.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当你在剪辑播客时，你会想，哦，这里有好多“嗯”。

sentences.en: But yeah, I'm going to embrace them.
sentences.zh: 不过是的，我要接纳它们。

sentences.en: And I'm also going to just think more mindfully about that.
sentences.zh: 而且我也会更有意识地去思考这一点。

sentences.en: I know that my audience will have listened to you saying, you know, there's these key concepts in emotional intelligence.
sentences.zh: 我知道我的听众会听过你说，你知道，情商中有这些核心概念。

sentences.en: I don't expect you to go through them all.
sentences.zh: 我不指望你把它们一一过一遍。

sentences.en: But could you give us like a flavor of a couple of your favorites of the key components, please?
sentences.zh: 但你能否给我们大致讲讲其中几个你最喜欢的核心要素呢？

sentences.en: I think these will resonate with a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 我想这些会引起很多人的共鸣。

sentences.en: So let's think about emotional intelligence as almost like a mountain.
sentences.zh: 所以让我们把情商想象成一座山。

sentences.en: So you have the bit that you can see and then the bit that goes underneath that you really didn't know was there or you didn't know how it's made up.
sentences.zh: 你有你看得到的部分，然后是藏在下面、你真的不知道它在那里或是不知道它是如何构成的部分。

sentences.en: So the bit that most people know about when it comes to emotional intelligence is that it's made up of four quadrants.
sentences.zh: 所以大多数人在谈到情商时都知道的部分是，它由四个象限组成。

sentences.en: OK, now, each one of these quadrants is critically important in any leadership journey.
sentences.zh: 好了，现在，在任何领导力成长之旅中，这四个象限中的每一个都至关重要。

sentences.en: So those four quadrants are self-awareness.
sentences.zh: 所以这四个象限之一就是自我意识。

sentences.en: Any leader worth their salt should have the ability, the constant ability to reflect, inwardly reflect.
sentences.zh: 任何合格的领导者都应该具备一种能力，即持续反思、内省的能力。

sentences.en: And as a consequence of that, be able to move on to the second quadrant, which is self-management.
sentences.zh: 而作为其结果，能够进入第二个象限，即自我管理。

sentences.en: Now, let me throw some examples in here so it makes sense.
sentences.zh: 现在，让我在这里举几个例子，以便说清楚。

sentences.en: So, for example, despite the fact that I did 32 years in police service, I've got nearly three decades worth of leadership experience behind me.
sentences.zh: 所以，举个例子，尽管我在警务部门工作了32年，我背后有将近三十年的领导经验。

sentences.en: I am still constantly curious and I'm still growing.
sentences.zh: 但我仍然保持着强烈的好奇心，并且仍在不断成长。

sentences.en: So I recently was honored to have been invited into a very, very select society of leaders.
sentences.zh: 所以最近我很荣幸被邀请加入一个非常、非常精选的领导者社群。

sentences.en: It's called the Society of Leadership Fellows in Windsor Castle.
sentences.zh: 它被称为温莎城堡的领导力研究员学会。

sentences.en: There's only 250 fellows in the whole world.
sentences.zh: 全世界只有250名研究员。

sentences.en: So for me to have been chosen, I was like, wow, you know, where did this come from?
sentences.zh: 所以对我来说，能被选中，我当时觉得，哇，你知道，这怎么会落到我头上？

sentences.en: So I had my first opportunity to go to a physical meeting and it was just a few days ago.
sentences.zh: 所以我有机会第一次去参加线下会议，就在几天前。

sentences.en: I think it was last Friday and it was a beautiful summer's day and I drove to Windsor Castle and I drove over there.
sentences.zh: 我想是上周五，那是一个美丽的夏日，我开车去了温莎城堡，然后把车开到了那边。

sentences.en: I got a security pass so I could walk into those areas that other people couldn't walk into.
sentences.zh: 我拿到了一张安保通行证，这样我就可以走到别人走不到的区域。

sentences.en: And I just found myself as I'm looking over this balustrade and I'm looking across the field and I could see Eaton, Eaton College in the distance.
sentences.zh: 当我俯瞰这个栏杆、望向田野时，我发现自己能看到远处的伊顿公学。

sentences.en: I'm thinking, wow, where have I landed?
sentences.zh: 我在想，哇，我这是落脚到哪儿了？

sentences.en: But the whole day was incredibly deep for me because they took us, they helped us to, the concept of that day was crafting your story as a leader.
sentences.zh: 但对整整一天，对我来说都极其深远，因为他们带我们……帮我们……那一天的核心理念就是打造你的领导者故事。

sentences.en: And the idea was to explore where you've been in terms of your learning, your understanding, your values, your visions, and to follow that story through to where you are right now.
sentences.zh: 其理念是探索你在学习、理解、价值观、愿景方面的经历，并将这个故事贯穿到你现在的状态。

sentences.en: So at the conclusion of the day, it was, where are you right now?
sentences.zh: 所以在活动结束时，问题是，你现在在哪里？

sentences.en: And we were asked to write down about three or four paragraphs describing where we were right now.
sentences.zh: 我们被要求写下大约三到四段话，描述我们现在的处境。

sentences.en: Now, I've got that written down here in front of me.
sentences.zh: 现在，我把它写在这里，就在我面前。

sentences.en: I found myself just sitting down and I just wrote.
sentences.zh: 我发现自己坐下来就开始写。

sentences.en: I had it done in five minutes.
sentences.zh: 我五分钟就搞定了。

sentences.en: I just wrote about three or four paragraphs in a language that I wouldn't ordinarily have used.
sentences.zh: 我用一种我平时不会用的语言写了大约三四段话。

sentences.en: But I remember one phrase that I used.
sentences.zh: 但我记得我用过的一个短语。

sentences.en: I said, I find myself looking at myself as if I were in a glass box, such as similar to the one in Crystal Maze,
sentences.zh: 我说，我发现自己看着自己，就像我身处一个玻璃箱里，类似于《水晶迷宫》里的那个箱子，

sentences.en: where there is air being pumped into this box and there's ticker tape literally all around me.
sentences.zh: 那里有空气被泵入这个箱子，四周 literalmente 全是纸带。

sentences.en: And on every piece of ticker tape is the word opportunity.
sentences.zh: 每一条纸带上都写着“机遇”这个词。

sentences.en: Those that I grab, I own.
sentences.zh: 那些我抓住的，就是我的。

sentences.en: Those that I don't, I don't worry about.
sentences.zh: 那些我没抓住的，我也不担心。

sentences.en: Because there is so much opportunity in my hand right now that I can actually do anything that I want with it.
sentences.zh: 因为我手中现在有如此多的机遇，我实际上可以用它做任何我想做的事。

sentences.en: And it's true to where I am right now.
sentences.zh: 这确实符合我目前的现状。

sentences.en: Just lately, in the last year, I have been involved in all sorts of leadership development prograMs.
sentences.zh: 就在最近这一年里，我参与了各种各样的领导力发展项目。

sentences.en: I've carried out cultural diagnostic audits of organizations.
sentences.zh: 我负责过各种组织的文化诊断审计。

sentences.en: I co-created a police drama that's being filmed, as we speak right now, by the BBC in Scotland.
sentences.zh: 我共同创作了一部警匪剧，目前正在苏格兰由BBC进行拍摄。

sentences.en: I mean, I never thought that would happen.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我从没想过这会发生。

sentences.en: And I've learned the philosophy for me in life is just to say yes to everything.
sentences.zh: 而且我学到的人生哲学就是对一切都说“好”。

sentences.en: And when I say yes to everything, all the things I want to be, that excite me will come my way.
sentences.zh: 当我对外说“好”时，所有我想成为的、让我兴奋的事情都会向我走来。

sentences.en: And some will drop off the edge, but a lot of them will stick and will just go forward.
sentences.zh: 有些会从边缘掉落，但很多会留下来并继续前行。

sentences.en: And it's created this abundant life.
sentences.zh: 它创造了这样一种丰盛的生活。

sentences.en: So leadership awareness, self-awareness is critically important.
sentences.zh: 所以领导力意识、自我意识是至关重要的。

sentences.en: Self-management is really about understanding, okay, so what are the habits?
sentences.zh: 自我管理实际上是关于理解，好吧，那么有哪些习惯？

sentences.en: What are the things that don't serve me and what am I going to do about them?
sentences.zh: 有哪些对我不利的习惯，我该怎么处理它们？

sentences.en: So this is really hard.
sentences.zh: 所以这真的很难。

sentences.en: This is stuff that you have to give up or where you're creating new habits.
sentences.zh: 这些是你必须放弃的东西，或者说你要养成新习惯的地方。

sentences.en: So when I wrote my book, Smash the Habit, it was really about physical habits.
sentences.zh: 所以当我写《粉碎习惯》这本书时，它 realmente 谈的是身体习惯。

sentences.en: You know, 20 years ago, I was a big smoker, big drinker, big meat eater.
sentences.zh: 你知道，20年前，我是一个重度吸烟者、重度饮酒者、肉食爱好者。

sentences.en: I was the guy, if I went into a restaurant, I had to have the biggest steak on the menu.
sentences.zh: 我就是那种人，如果我走进餐厅，我必须点菜单上最大的牛排。

sentences.en: And overnight, I stopped drinking, smoking, eating meat, fish, eggs, and I have never turned back.
sentences.zh: 一夜之间，我戒掉了酒、烟、肉、鱼、鸡蛋，而且我再也没有回头。

sentences.en: Seven years ago, I gave up drinking fizzy pop, sugary drinks, tea, and coffee overnight, and I've never gone back.
sentences.zh: 七年前，我一夜之间戒掉了碳酸饮料、含糖饮料、茶和咖啡，再也没有回头。

sentences.en: Six years ago, I gave up drinking milk.
sentences.zh: 六年前，我戒掉了牛奶。

sentences.en: You must have had some withdrawal headaches, I'm thinking, from all of that.
sentences.zh: 我想，由于这一切，你一定经历过一些戒断性头痛吧。

sentences.en: Do you know what?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗？

sentences.en: I genuinely cannot remember if I had it.
sentences.zh: 我真的记不清我当时有没有头痛了。

sentences.en: I must have had something.
sentences.zh: 我肯定有过某种反应。

sentences.en: But my passion was so strong that I would have just ridden over it.
sentences.zh: 但我的热情是如此强烈，以至于我完全可以跨过去。

sentences.en: And this is to say that I'm not unique.
sentences.zh: 这说明我并不是独一无二的。

sentences.en: It's just that the clarity of thought was so powerful for me that I was much more committed.
sentences.zh: 只是我的思维清晰度对我和我而言是如此强大，以至于我投入了更多。

sentences.en: And that's what quadrant two of emotional intelligence is all about.
sentences.zh: 这就是情商第二象限的全部内容。

sentences.en: Quadrant three is saying, okay, now that I've fixed myself, now let's look outside of myself.
sentences.zh: 第三象限是说，好吧，既然我已经修复了自己，现在让我们把目光投向自我之外。

sentences.en: So quadrant three is all about social awareness, really understanding how the world works around you.
sentences.zh: 所以第三象限完全关于社会意识，真正理解你周围的世界是如何运作的。

sentences.en: So if you're in an organization, for example, or let's assume that you're going for a doctoral program.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果你身处一个组织中，或者，比方说你正在攻读博士学位。

sentences.en: This is one of the things I taught the delegates that came onto the program.
sentences.zh: 这是我教给参加该项目的学员的事情之一。

sentences.en: I said, what are the expectations do you think of you being on a doctoral program?
sentences.zh: 我说，你认为读博对你有什么期望？

sentences.en: What are the hoops that you have to jump through?
sentences.zh: 有哪些你要经历的繁文缛节？

sentences.en: What policies are there?
sentences.zh: 有哪些政策？

sentences.en: What givens are there that you have to achieve?
sentences.zh: 有哪些你必须达成的既定条件？

sentences.en: And how many of you have ever tried that and still failed?
sentences.zh: 你们中有多少人尝试过这些却仍然失败了？

sentences.en: And a lot of them put their hands up and said, okay, so what else is there?
sentences.zh: 他们中的许多人举手说，好吧，那还有什么？

sentences.en: What is underneath the surface?
sentences.zh: 水面之下是什么？

sentences.en: What are the nuances?
sentences.zh: 有哪些细微差别？

sentences.en: What is the language that goes on?
sentences.zh: 有什么样的通用语言？

sentences.en: What are the groups that you can go and visit, that you can align yourself with?
sentences.zh: 你可以去拜访哪些群体，可以与哪些群体结盟？

sentences.en: What relationships can you develop?
sentences.zh: 你能建立什么关系？

sentences.en: What conversations can you have that actually increases your level of knowledge, your overall level of knowledge?
sentences.zh: 你能进行什么样的对话来真正提高你的知识水平、你的整体知识水平？

sentences.en: And it's the same in organizations.
sentences.zh: 在组织中也是如此。

sentences.en: A lot of people get frustrated in organizations and say, oh, I don't fit here, you know, and I will never get promoted.
sentences.zh: 许多人在组织中感到沮丧，并说，哦，我不适合这里，你知道，我永远不会得到晋升。

sentences.en: And the reason why they get frustrated is because they don't understand the nuances of the organization.
sentences.zh: 他们感到沮丧的原因是他们不理解这个组织的细微差别。

sentences.en: And this is not about nepotism.
sentences.zh: 这与裙带关系无关。

sentences.en: It's just the nuances because wherever there are human beings, you will always find these subconscious,
sentences.zh: 这只是细微差别，因为只要有人类的地方，你总会发现这些潜意识的、

sentences.en: unconscious biases that exist because it's a natural facet of being a human being.
sentences.zh: 无意识的偏见存在，因为这是身为人类的自然一面。

sentences.en: So start understanding that kind of stuff.
sentences.zh: 所以开始理解这些东西吧。

sentences.en: And finally, and probably the most important and probably the most powerful, if you get it right, is relationship building.
sentences.zh: 最后，可能也是最重要、如果你做对了的话也最强大的，就是关系建立。

sentences.en: Who do you reach out to to build one-on-one relationships, deep, lasting relationships?
sentences.zh: 你向谁伸出援手来建立一对一的关系，建立深厚、持久的关系？

sentences.en: I'm an introvert by nature.
sentences.zh: 我本质上是一个内向的人。

sentences.en: Despite the fact that I can stand on a stage and speak to a thousand people, my introversion is such that I prefer one-on-one conversations.
sentences.zh: 尽管我可以站在舞台上对一千人演讲，但我的内向让我更喜欢一对一的对话。

sentences.en: But when I meet people, I develop strong, deep, lasting relationships.
sentences.zh: 但当我遇到人时，我会建立强大、深厚、持久的关系。

sentences.en: And that's who I am.
sentences.zh: 这就是我。

sentences.en: But when you do that, then you'll find that people will elevate you as you elevate other people.
sentences.zh: 但当你这样做时，你会发现，当你提升他人时，人们也会提升你。

sentences.en: People will recommend you as you recommend other people.
sentences.zh: 当你推荐他人时，人们也会推荐你。

sentences.en: Your relationships become much, much of a higher quality.
sentences.zh: 你的关系会变得质量高得多、高得多。

sentences.en: So those are just the four quadrants.
sentences.zh: 所以这些就是四个象限。

sentences.en: Now, beyond those four quadrants, there's 26 competency areas.
sentences.zh: 现在，在这四个象限之外，还有26个胜任力领域。

sentences.en: So within the 26 competency areas, there's all sorts like personal power is a really big one for me.
sentences.zh: 所以在26个胜任力领域中，有各种各样的，比如个人力量对我来说是一个非常大的领域。

sentences.en: Personal power was the one competency area that was actually pulling my overall EQ score down.
sentences.zh: 个人力量是那个实际上在拉低我整体EQ得分的胜任力领域。

sentences.en: I have a very high EQ score only because I've been working on it, not because I'm some kind of a superhero or something like that.
sentences.zh: 我拥有很高的EQ得分，只是因为我一直在努力，而不是因为我是什么超级英雄之类的人。

sentences.en: I used to have a poor EQ sort of profile, but I've worked on it over the years.
sentences.zh: 我过去曾经有过糟糕的EQ得分档案，但我多年来一直在努力改进。

sentences.en: But this one competency is still dragging it down.
sentences.zh: 但这个单一的胜任力仍在把它往下拉。

sentences.en: And personal power is really about your relationship with you.
sentences.zh: 个人力量实际上是关于你与你自己的关系。

sentences.en: What kind of conversations are you having with you?
sentences.zh: 你在和自己进行什么样的对话？

sentences.en: So we talk about imposter syndrome.
sentences.zh: 所以我们谈论冒名顶替综合症。

sentences.en: We talk about self-esteem.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论自尊。

sentences.en: All that fits within this concept of personal power.
sentences.zh: 所有这些都符合个人力量这个概念。

sentences.en: So we need to find out how do we improve?
sentences.zh: 所以我们需要弄清楚我们如何改进？

sentences.en: How can we improve our self-esteem?
sentences.zh: 我们如何才能提高我们的自尊？

sentences.en: How can we have better quality conversations with ourselves?
sentences.zh: 我们如何才能与自己进行更高质量的对话？

sentences.en: How can we build a better relationship with ourselves that is as good as the relationships that we have with other people?
sentences.zh: 我们如何才能与自己建立一段和我们与他人之间的关系一样美好的关系？

sentences.en: Sometimes we are our worst enemy and we can be the biggest bully to ourselves.
sentences.zh: 有时候我们自己是我们自己最大的敌人，我们可能会对自我霸凌得最厉害。

sentences.en: And yet we wouldn't look to, wouldn't tolerate bullying in anybody else.
sentences.zh: 然而我们却不会去寻找、也不会容忍对其他任何人的霸凌。

sentences.en: So for me, this is about changing language and constantly being aware of the language that we're using with ourselves on a day-to-day basis.
sentences.zh: 所以对我来说，这是关于改变语言，并时刻意识到我们在日常生活中对自我使用的语言。

sentences.en: Learning how to reframe that language, challenge that language.
sentences.zh: 学会重新构架这种语言，挑战这种语言。

sentences.en: And sometimes if the language cannot be changed, then it's about watching your actions because that language will lead to actions or inaction.
sentences.zh: 有时候如果语言无法改变，那么就要注意你的行动，因为这些语言会导致行动或不作为。

sentences.en: So watching your actions, really policing your mind, using the analogy from my past, policing your mind and policing your actions.
sentences.zh: 所以注意你的行动，真正管理你的思维，用我过去的类比，管理你的思维和管理你的行动。

sentences.en: So if your thinking is not of a good quality, you adjust that.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你的思维质量不高，你就去调整它。

sentences.en: If you're not able to adjust that, then it's actually looking at the action.
sentences.zh: 如果你无法调整它，那么实际上就要看行动了。

sentences.en: So you might find yourself doing something or not doing something as the case may be and saying, actually, that's not good for me.
sentences.zh: 所以你可能会发现自己在做某事或没有做某事，视情况而定，然后说，事实上，这对我不利。

sentences.en: So I need to get off my backside and I need to go and, you know, we were talking about LinkedIn a while ago, Marianne, and we're talking about improving our profiles on LinkedIn.
sentences.zh: 所以我需要离开我的后背，我需要去……你知道的，我们不久前在谈论领英，玛丽安，我们在谈论如何在领英上完善我们的资料。

sentences.en: I thought to myself, I really don't want to do this, but I need to do it.
sentences.zh: 我心想，我真的不想做这个，但我必须做。

sentences.en: So let's get it done.
sentences.zh: 所以把它完成吧。

sentences.en: So that's my attitude in life now to overcome my personal power issues.
sentences.zh: 这就是我目前克服个人力量问题的人生态度。

sentences.en: I just tell myself the job needs to get it done.
sentences.zh: 我只告诉自己，这项工作必须完成。

sentences.en: So I've coined a phrase, which you might see up here.
sentences.zh: 所以我创造了一个短语，你可能在这里看到。

sentences.en: Do it now.
sentences.zh: 立即行动。

sentences.en: It says hashtag do it now.
sentences.zh: 上面写着话题标签“立即行动”。

sentences.en: And for me, the moment I think about doing something, whether it's grasping an opportunity or doing something that I really don't want to do.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，从我想到要做某事的那一刻起，无论是抓住一个机会，还是去做一件我真的不想做的事。

sentences.en: Brian Tracy will call it eating your frog, doing a task that's unpleasant.
sentences.zh: 博恩·崔西会称之为吃掉你的青蛙，也就是去做一件令人不快的工作。

sentences.en: I just get it done and I get it done in the here and now.
sentences.zh: 我只会把事情做好，而且是立竿见影地做好。

sentences.en: Do it now.
sentences.zh: 现在就做。

sentences.en: And that philosophy has served me well.
sentences.zh: 这种理念让我受益匪浅。

sentences.en: I used to be the worst procrastinator in the world, but now at least I get things done, you know.
sentences.zh: 我曾经是世界上最严重的拖延症患者，但现在至少我能把事情做完，你知道的。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: It's really powerful stuff.
sentences.zh: 这真的是很有力量的东西。

sentences.en: And, you know, reflecting on what you've said, you know, I trained in the doctoral program between 2008 and 2011,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，反思你刚才所说的话，我是在2008年到2011年期间参加博士项目培训的，

sentences.en: and it was very much about upskilling us to have the necessary skills to be a good enough clinician with our clients, our mental health clients, when we were in the room.
sentences.zh: 当时非常注重提升我们的技能，让我们在面对客户——我们的心理健康客户时，具备作为一名合格临床医生所需的技能。

sentences.en: But there wasn't really much of an emphasis on compassion and self-talk and the quality of your thoughts.
sentences.zh: 但并没有真正花太多心思去强调同理心、内心独白以及你的思维品质。

sentences.en: And I really have spent time since I've been supporting aspiring psychologists really trying to warm up the compassion,
sentences.zh: 自从我开始支持有志成为心理学家的人以来，我真的花了很多时间去努力培养同理心，

sentences.en: warm up the temperature of the water and encourage people to look after themselves, because often there won't be anyone coming to rescue you.
sentences.zh: 给水的温度加热，并鼓励人们照顾好自己，因为通常不会有人来拯救你。

sentences.en: And I think I really hope that the doctoral programs are going to start embracing and doing some more of that as well.
sentences.zh: 我想我真的很希望博士项目也能开始接受并做更多这方面的事情。

sentences.en: So there was personal development.
sentences.zh: 所以当时有个人发展培训。

sentences.en: There was a personal tutor relationship.
sentences.zh: 有导师关系。

sentences.en: But in terms of the stuff I needed to get me through life, you know, in terms of becoming a parent and losing a dad and, you know,
sentences.zh: 但就我生活所需的东西而言，你知道的，比如成为父母、经历丧父之痛，你知道，

sentences.en: managing a busy, you know, caseload and teams and stepping into leadership roles when I hadn't really been taught how to do that, compassion is needed.
sentences.zh: 管理繁忙的病历档案和团队，在没有真正接受过如何做的情况下担任领导角色，这些都需要同理心。

sentences.en: You know, like you said, you've had imposter syndrome and even me as a qualified psychologist,
sentences.zh: 你知道，就像你说的，你经历过冒名顶替综合征，甚至连我这个合格的心理学家——

sentences.en: I've been qualified 10 years, over 10 years.
sentences.zh: 我已经获得资质10年了，超过10年了。

sentences.en: You still have imposter syndrome, you know?
sentences.zh: 你还是会有冒名顶替综合征，你知道吗？

sentences.en: Of course.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是的。

sentences.en: And that's OK.
sentences.zh: 这没关系。

sentences.en: But that's really normal.
sentences.zh: 但这真的很正常。

sentences.en: It's just part of having these really tricky human brains of ours.
sentences.zh: 这只是我们拥有这些极其复杂的聪明大脑的一部分而已。

sentences.en: And so I really hope that with, you know, your support and the support of other people that have got compassionate voices in the field,
sentences.zh: 所以我真的希望，在你的支持下，以及领域内其他具有同情心之声的人的支持下，

sentences.en: that we can not just equip fully qualified clinical psychologists, but to equip people with life skills that help them to be able to navigate their own lives,
sentences.zh: 我们不仅能武装完全合格的临床心理学家，还能为人们配备生活技能，帮助他们驾驭自己的生活，

sentences.en: which then help people to navigate their clients' lives as well.
sentences.zh: 进而帮助人们去驾驭他们客户的生活。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是的。

sentences.en: You know, this whole issue of imposter syndrome,
sentences.zh: 你知道，冒名顶替综合征这个整体问题，

sentences.en: we talk about it as if we're the only people that suffer from it.
sentences.zh: 我们谈论它时，好像我们是唯一受其折磨的人。

sentences.en: I would suggest that 90% of the people that you meet on a day-to-day basis will have some level of imposter syndrome.
sentences.zh: 我敢说，你日常生活中遇到的90%的人都会有某种程度的冒名顶替综合征。

sentences.en: I recall when I was a senior police officer and a highly, highly specialised critical incident gold commander.
sentences.zh: 我记得当我还是一名高级警官和一个高度专业化的重大事故黄金指挥官的时候。

sentences.en: I was like at the top end, the very top end of any major incident.
sentences.zh: 我处于顶端，处于任何重大事故的最顶端。

sentences.en: I was, I'd been on so many courses, I was highly experienced.
sentences.zh: 我参加过无数的课程，经验非常丰富。

sentences.en: And, you know, thankfully, that touch wood, I'd never made a mistake in that sense where somebody's life was at risk.
sentences.zh: 而且，谢天谢地，摸摸木头，我在那种危及他人生命的意义上从未犯过错。

sentences.en: But do you know what?
sentences.zh: 但你知道吗？

sentences.en: Every single time with every single incident, there was a touch of imposter syndrome.
sentences.zh: 每一次面对每一个事故，都会有一丝冒名顶替综合征。

sentences.en: So in whichever field you're in, I would suspect that at some point in time, if we are not guarding the gates of our mind, the imposter syndrome will creep through.
sentences.zh: 所以在你所处的任何领域，我都会怀疑，在某些时候，如果我们不守卫心灵的大门，冒名顶替综合征就会悄然侵入。

sentences.en: So we need to be prepared all the time.
sentences.zh: 所以我们需要时刻准备着。

sentences.en: We need to be alert all the time for these, this negative language, these limiting beliefs creeping in.
sentences.zh: 我们需要时刻保持警惕，防范这些负面语言、这些限制性信念的潜入。

sentences.en: And we need to have some kind of a strategy to deal with them.
sentences.zh: 我们需要某种策略来应对它们。

sentences.en: And when it comes to emotional intelligence and EQ,
sentences.zh: 当谈到情商和EQ时，

sentences.en: I think we have been conditioned to believe that technical skills, qualifications and IQ are everything that you need in life to be successful in life.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们一直被灌输一种观念，认为技术技能、学历和IQ是在生活中取得成功所需的一切。

sentences.en: But that's not true, as you've just quite rightly identified there.
sentences.zh: 但正如你刚才非常正确地指出那样，事实并非如此。

sentences.en: IQ, technical skills and qualification will get you to a certain point.
sentences.zh: 智商、技术技能和学历只能让你走到某个阶段。

sentences.en: But if beyond that point you want to be successful, then it has to be about EQ.
sentences.zh: 但如果超越了这个阶段你还想成功，那就必须依靠情商。

sentences.en: It has to be about how good is the conversation that you're having with you?
sentences.zh: 这必须取决于你与自己的对话质量有多高？

sentences.en: How good are the conversations that you're having with other people?
sentences.zh: 你与他人对话的质量有多高？

sentences.en: How good are you at understanding the social context in the environment in which you live, work or operate?
sentences.zh: 你对你生活、工作或行事的社会环境的理解能力有多强？

sentences.en: And how well can you manage your behavior or manage or perceive the emotions in other people?
sentences.zh: 你如何很好地管理自己的行为，或者管理和感知他人的情绪？

sentences.en: How well can you read a situation?
sentences.zh: 你解读局势的能力有多强？

sentences.en: How well can you read people?
sentences.zh: 你看人的眼光有多准？

sentences.en: How well can you communicate?
sentences.zh: 你的沟通能力有多强？

sentences.en: What kind of language do you use?
sentences.zh: 你使用什么样的语言？

sentences.en: What's your tonality like?
sentences.zh: 你的语调是怎样的？

sentences.en: What's your connectability like?
sentences.zh: 你的亲和力/连接力是怎样的？

sentences.en: All of these kind of things are absolutely critically important.
sentences.zh: 所有这些事情都是绝对至关重要的。

sentences.en: And you've touched upon something very important, Marion.
sentences.zh: 马里昂，你触及了一个非常重要的事情。

sentences.en: I absolutely believe that when you have high levels of emotional intelligence from that, you'll also build high levels of emotional resilience.
sentences.zh: 我坚信，当你拥有高水平的情商时，你也会建立起高水平的情绪韧性。

sentences.en: So when you do come under these very testing and challenging times, let's face it, we all will or do at some point.
sentences.zh: 因此，当你经历这些非常考验和充满挑战的时期时——面对现实吧，我们所有人在某个时刻都会或已经经历过。

sentences.en: I literally have lost count of how many dead bodies I've seen or how many postmortems I've been to.
sentences.zh: 我简直数不清自己看过多少具尸体，去过多少次解剖现场。

sentences.en: That emotional resilience doesn't just come automatically.
sentences.zh: 这种情绪韧性并不是自然而然就有的。

sentences.en: It can be built over time when you learn how to identify your thoughts and your emotions and how they impact on your thinking.
sentences.zh: 它是随着时间的推移，当你学会如何识别自己的想法和情绪以及它们如何影响你的思维时建立起来的。

sentences.en: And then learn how to make friends with yourself so that your emotions don't serve as the chimpanzee, as Steve Peters often talks about in this chimp paradox.
sentences.zh: 然后学会与自己化敌为友，这样你的情绪就不会像史蒂夫·彼得斯在《黑猩猩悖论》中经常谈到的那样变成那只黑猩猩。

sentences.en: It's not some wild creature inside your brain running wild, so you become irrational.
sentences.zh: 它不是你脑海中胡作非为的野兽，让你变得不理智。

sentences.en: You have to allow your prefrontal cortex to kick in so you can make these rational, logical, empathic decisions in life.
sentences.zh: 你必须让你的前额叶皮层发挥作用，这样你才能在生活中做出这些理性的、合乎逻辑的、有同理心的决定。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, absolutely, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 对，对，绝对是，绝对是。

sentences.en: It's really golden stuff, Carl.
sentences.zh: 卡尔，这真的是非常有价值的干货。

sentences.en: Have you got like top tips for if people want to like make a change that's going to make a big change for them?
sentences.zh: 如果你有什么顶级建议给那些想要做出能带来巨大改变的人，你有什么看法吗？

sentences.en: What would be like your take home piece of advice?
sentences.zh: 你带回家的核心建议是什么？

sentences.en: Well, I would suggest something around self-awareness is critical.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为围绕自我意识的一些东西是至关重要的。

sentences.en: In this very, very fast world in which we exist, it's very hard nowadays to actually sit down,
sentences.zh: 在我们生存的这个非常非常快的世界里，现在很难真正坐下来，

sentences.en: put the phones away, all of these distracting things away, and actually sit down with a pen and paper.
sentences.zh: 把手机收起来，把所有这些让人分心的东西收起来，真正拿出一支笔和一张纸坐下来。

sentences.en: And in doing that, really analyze where you've been and where you intend to go and where you are right now.
sentences.zh: 在这样做的过程中，真正剖析你曾经去过哪里、你打算去哪里以及你现在在哪里。

sentences.en: And within that, it's almost like doing a SWOT analysis on yourself.
sentences.zh: 在这个过程中，这几乎就像是在对你自己做SWOT分析。

sentences.en: What are your strengths in everything that you've ever done and everything that you could ever do?
sentences.zh: 在你做过的一切和你可能做过的一切中，你的优势是什么？

sentences.en: What are the weaknesses in everything that you've ever experienced?
sentences.zh: 在你经历过的一切中，劣势是什么？

sentences.en: What you could do in the future?
sentences.zh: 你未来能做什么？

sentences.en: What could be your future weaknesses?
sentences.zh: 你未来的劣势可能是什么？

sentences.en: But in doing the weaknesses, I would suggest that you look for evidence-based thinking.
sentences.zh: 但在分析劣势时，我建议你寻找基于证据的思考。

sentences.en: We can make up all the weaknesses in the world, but what's the evidence to substantiate that this is actually a credible weakness?
sentences.zh: 我们可以捏造出世上所有的劣势，但有什么证据能证实这确实是一个可靠的劣势呢？

sentences.en: So I have to put this caveat.
sentences.zh: 所以我必须加上这个附加说明。

sentences.en: You're doing a bit of CBT there, Carl, whether you know it or not.
sentences.zh: 卡尔，你刚才其实在用一点CBT（认知行为疗法），不管你知不知道。

sentences.en: And then, of course, the opportunities.
sentences.zh: 当然，接下来是机遇。

sentences.en: So what is it around you in life?
sentences.zh: 那么你生活周围有什么？

sentences.en: What relationships exist or potential relationships?
sentences.zh: 存在什么关系，或者潜在的关系是什么？

sentences.en: What access do you have to in groups, environments that you could now nurture and grow and evolve?
sentences.zh: 你有什么途径接触到内群体、环境，你可以去培育、发展和进化它们？

sentences.en: What relationships?
sentences.zh: 有什么关系？

sentences.en: And finally, the threats.
sentences.zh: 最后，是威胁。

sentences.en: So I don't like the threats part.
sentences.zh: 我不喜欢威胁这部分。

sentences.en: You know, when we talk about the SWOT analysis, I very rarely pay much attention to threat.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当我们谈论SWOT分析时，我很少关注威胁。

sentences.en: I'll tell you before why.
sentences.zh: 我之前会告诉你原因。

sentences.en: So we're conditioned from the moment that we are born to live in a very competitive environment.
sentences.zh: 我们从出生那一刻起就被灌输要在竞争激烈的环境中生活。

sentences.en: So even in business, people talk about competitors.
sentences.zh: 所以即使在商业中，人们也在谈论竞争对手。

sentences.en: I literally have no competitors.
sentences.zh: 我真的没有竞争对手。

sentences.en: That's my vision in life.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的人生愿景。

sentences.en: I have no competitors in life, no competitors in business.
sentences.zh: 我在生活中没有竞争对手，在商业中也没有竞争对手。

sentences.en: I had no competitors in the police service.
sentences.zh: 我在警队里也没有竞争对手。

sentences.en: I can only compete with me.
sentences.zh: 我只能与自己竞争。

sentences.en: So if there is a threat, it's the quality of the person that you are in the here and now, how you're showing up.
sentences.zh: 所以如果有威胁，那就是此时此刻作为你的那个人的质量，你表现得怎么样。

sentences.en: Don't worry about the potential competitors around you.
sentences.zh: 不要担心你身边的潜在竞争对手。

sentences.en: There's a really good book, I don't know if you know, from Simon Sinek, who is one of my heroes in leadership.
sentences.zh: 有一本非常好的书，我不知道你知不知道，作者是西蒙·斯涅克，他是我的领导力偶像之一。

sentences.en: Simon Sinek talks about the infinite mind.
sentences.zh: 西蒙·斯涅克谈到了无限思维。

sentences.en: I think it's called the infinite game, but he talks about the infinite mind.
sentences.zh: 我想这本书叫《无限游戏》，但他谈到了无限思维。

sentences.en: He says in life, there are two mindsets.
sentences.zh: 他说在生活中，有两种思维方式。

sentences.en: There's the infinite mindset and there's a finite mindset.
sentences.zh: 一种是无限思维，另一种是有限思维。

sentences.en: The finite mindset is the leader who has a winning poSt.
sentences.zh: 有限思维就是那种有着获胜终点的领导者。

sentences.en: They say, right, by the time I'm 30, I want to achieve this.
sentences.zh: 他们说，好，到我30岁时，我要实现这个。

sentences.en: Or my goal now is to get to here.
sentences.zh: 或者我现在的目标是到达这里。

sentences.en: But then you have to ask yourself, well, when you get to that winning post, when you get to that goal, what then?
sentences.zh: 但接着你必须问自己，当你到达那个终点时，当你达成那个目标时，接下来呢？

sentences.en: And that for me is a finite mindset.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，那是一种有限思维。

sentences.en: It's a very limiting mindset.
sentences.zh: 这是一种非常局限的思维方式。

sentences.en: Whereas the infinite mindset says, I want to go in this direction and I want to keep going and keep learning and keep being curious.
sentences.zh: 而无限思维则说，我想朝这个方向前进，我想继续前进、不断学习、保持好奇心。

sentences.en: I want to keep growing throughout the entirety of my journey.
sentences.zh: 我希望在我的整个旅程中不断成长。

sentences.en: And what you'll find is if they were to go for the same amount of period, the one with a growth mindset, the infinite mindset,
sentences.zh: 你会发现，如果他们经历相同的时间长度，那个具有成长型思维、无限思维的人，

sentences.en: will have grown 10 times than the person with a finite mindset.
sentences.zh: 将会比具有有限思维的人成长十倍。

sentences.en: So do a SWOT analysis on yourself, use a caveat that I've put in place there, come at it with an infinite mindset and see where you are.
sentences.zh: 因此，对你自己做一个SWOT分析，使用我提出的那个附加条件，带着无限思维来审视，看看你在哪里。

sentences.en: That's all about self-awareness.
sentences.zh: 这全关乎自我意识。

sentences.en: Really get an understanding of where you are, who you are in the here and now, and then you can start moving forward.
sentences.zh: 真正了解你在哪里，此时此刻你是谁，然后你就可以开始前进了。

sentences.en: Great.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: I wonder if the same might be useful for helping people step into their leadership as well.
sentences.zh: 我在想，同样的方法是否也可以用来帮助人们走上领导岗位。

sentences.en: Because as psychologists, we graduate as band seven in the NHS, which is quite high up, bearing in mind it now starts at band two, you know,
sentences.zh: 因为作为心理学家，我们在NHS（英国国家医疗服务体系）以七级（Band 7）毕业，这相当高，考虑到它现在从二级开始，你知道，

sentences.en: and generally the top of the pay scales will be banded at nine.
sentences.zh: 通常薪酬等级的上限是九级。

sentences.en: But they do go on beyond that for more senior levels, but they're not banded.
sentences.zh: 但更高的高级级别会超越这个范围，只是没有分级。

sentences.en: There's an expectation that you're going to have some sort of leadership role, ultimately.
sentences.zh: 人们期望你最终能担任某种领导角色。

sentences.en: Certainly as you go up to band eight, A and B and C, you know, and D, but that's sort of,
sentences.zh: 当然，当你升到八级A、B、C，你知道，还有D时，但这有点像，

sentences.en: it can be a tricky thing to get your head around the fact that maybe as soon as you qualify, you go from trainee to qualified, then they're looking for leadership.
sentences.zh: 这可能很难让人接受：也许一旦你获得资格，你从见习转为正式资格，然后他们就开始期待领导力。

sentences.en: And it's not necessarily something that's that easy to get experience of on the way up.
sentences.zh: 而在上升的过程中，这不一定是一件很容易积累经验的事情。

sentences.en: So how do we get our heads around that and get any good at it, Cole?
sentences.zh: 卡尔，我们该如何理解这一点并擅长它呢？

sentences.en: That's a really good question.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常好的问题。

sentences.en: I've done a lot of work with the NHS, both in terms of culture change and leadership development.
sentences.zh: 我与NHS合作过很多次，无论是在文化变革还是领导力发展方面。

sentences.en: And I understand how the bandings work, but there are a lot of positions where you are in a similar position to that which you've just described.
sentences.zh: 我理解分级是如何运作的，但在很多职位上，你的处境与你刚刚描述的类似。

sentences.en: So, for example, doctors.
sentences.zh: 例如，医生。

sentences.en: Doctors don't train to be leaders.
sentences.zh: 医生受训不是为了当领导。

sentences.en: They train to be doctors.
sentences.zh: 他们受训是为了当医生。

sentences.en: Dentists, I'm just doing some work with some dentists.
sentences.zh: 牙医，我最近正在和一些牙医合作。

sentences.en: They don't train to become a leader.
sentences.zh: 他们受训不是为了成为领导。

sentences.en: They train to become a dentist, but the addition to that is that they automatically are seen as leaders as soon as they start working, right?
sentences.zh: 他们受训成为牙医，但除此之外，他们一开始工作就被自动视为了领导，对吧？

sentences.en: And it's no different with psychologists.
sentences.zh: 心理学家也是如此。

sentences.en: So for me, leadership is not about the position that you own in an organization.
sentences.zh: 所以对A我而言，领导力无关乎你在组织中拥有的职位。

sentences.en: Leadership is about how you show up in life.
sentences.zh: 领导力关乎你在生活中如何表现自己。

sentences.en: Let me explain that in a bit more, with a bit more sort of common sense, really.
sentences.zh: 让我用更多一点常识来解释这一点。

sentences.en: I once trawled Google for the definition of leadership.
sentences.zh: 我曾经在谷歌上搜索过领导力的定义。

sentences.en: And firstly, I was astounded that on the word leadership, I came up with nearly 4 billion responses in 0.67 seconds,
sentences.zh: 首先，我大吃一惊，在“领导力”这个词上，我在0.67秒内得到了近40亿条结果，

sentences.en: which demonstrates that there's a lot of people interested in leadership.
sentences.zh: 这表明有很多人对领导力感兴趣。

sentences.en: Well, if it's nearly 4 billion, that's nearly half the world, right?
sentences.zh: 好吧，如果将近40亿，那几乎是世界的一半了，对吧？

sentences.en: But then when I looked for the definition of leadership, the definition I got was leadership is when you are leading an organization or you're leading a group of people.
sentences.zh: 但当我寻找领导力的定义时，我得到的定义是：领导力就是你领导一个组织或领导一群人。

sentences.en: Now, I don't know about you, but if you have to use a word leadership, sorry, leading to describe the word leadership,
sentences.zh: 现在，我不知道你怎么想，但如果你必须用“领导”这个词来定义“领导力”，

sentences.en: it's almost like the dictionary itself doesn't understand leadership.
sentences.zh: 这就好像字典本身都不理解领导力是什么。

sentences.en: So being a non-conformist, I came up with my own definition, which I think is far more accurate.
sentences.zh: 所以作为一个非遵从者，我提出了我自己的定义，我认为这要准确得多。

sentences.en: I think you are a leader whenever you are influencing people, you're influencing circumstances.
sentences.zh: 我认为只要你在影响他人、影响环境，你就是一个领导者。

sentences.en: Now, within that, that should help to identify the answers to your question, because we can, therefore, be a leader way before we become a doctor in psychology,
sentences.zh: 在这个基础上，这应该有助于找出你问题的答案，因为因此，早在我们成为心理学博士之前，

sentences.en: way before we become an adult even.
sentences.zh: 甚至早在我们成为成年人之前，我们就已经是了。

sentences.en: If we are influencing friends around us as a child, if we are influencing our children because we've birthed some children,
sentences.zh: 如果我们作为一个孩子在影响周围的朋友，如果我们因为生了孩子而在影响我们的孩子，

sentences.en: if we are influencing our pets because they look up to us for guidance as the alpha male, alpha female,
sentences.zh: 如果我们因为宠物把我们当成领头雄性、领头雌性来寻求指导而影响它们，

sentences.en: if we are influencing friends because they see us as being an expert in a certain area, so therefore they come to us for advice,
sentences.zh: 如果我们因为朋友视我们为某个领域的专家而向我们征求建议，从而影响他们，

sentences.en: or they just see us as an agony aunt and agony uncle, all of these are leadership roles.
sentences.zh: 或者他们只是把我们看作知心姐姐和知心叔叔，所有这些都是领导角色。

sentences.en: If you're the elder sibling, if you're the elder sibling, it's a leadership role.
sentences.zh: 如果你是长兄或长姐，这也是一个领导角色。

sentences.en: If your parents are getting old and they're now leaning on you, that's a leadership role.
sentences.zh: 如果你的父母老了，现在开始依靠你，那也是一个领导角色。

sentences.en: So if these are all leadership roles, and these are just roles in life, let alone working in the NHS or anywhere else,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果这些都是领导角色，而且这些只是生活中的角色，更不用说在NHS（英国国家医疗服务体系）或其他任何地方工作了，

sentences.en: it's as well that we start getting our leadership skills right from the outset.
sentences.zh: 我们最好从一开始就掌握好我们的领导技能。

sentences.en: It's about reading the books, it's about practicing emotional intelligence, it's about becoming much, much more self-aware, analyzing ourselves, it's about asking for feedback,
sentences.zh: 这关乎阅读书籍，关乎践行情商，关乎变得更有自我意识、剖析自我，关乎寻求反馈，

sentences.en: but then creating the environment for that person to feel safe to give you feedback.
sentences.zh: 但同时也需要为对方营造一种安全的氛围，让他们放心给你反馈。

sentences.en: You know, people often talk about asking for feedback, but it's no good unless you create a safe environment.
sentences.zh: 你知道，人们经常谈论寻求反馈，但如果不创造一个安全的氛围，那就毫无用处。

sentences.en: So the psychological safety for the individual giving the feedback back to you, if you do all of that, then actually you're already on the journey to becoming a leader.
sentences.zh: 因此，为向你提供反馈的个人建立心理安全感，如果你做到了这一切，那么实际上你已经踏上了成为领导者的旅程。

sentences.en: And the natural transition from you being at a band seven to going further thereafter is so subtle, it will almost be unnoticeable.
sentences.zh: 从七级（band seven）职位自然过渡到更高职位是如此微妙，几乎让人察觉不到。

sentences.en: So leadership is something that we can all learn.
sentences.zh: 所以领导力是我们所有人都能学会的东西。

sentences.en: It's not something that we're born with.
sentences.zh: 它不是我们生来就有的。

sentences.en: It's something that we learn throughout the entirety of our lives.
sentences.zh: 它是我们在整个人生中不断学习的东西。

sentences.en: But we have to look for leadership in the most, in the most sort of unexpected areas of our lives, don't align it to our work or position, align it to who we are.
sentences.zh: 但我们必须在生活中最意想不到的领域去寻找领导力，不要把它与我们的工作或职位挂钩，要把它与我们是谁挂钩。

sentences.en: So the boots on the ground example for our audience would be, I guess,
sentences.zh: 所以对于我们的听众来说，切合实际的例子可能是，我想，

sentences.en: cultural temperature of organizations and how people want to show up in terms of dignity and respect for their clients, taking time for their colleagues, you know,
sentences.zh: 组织的文化氛围，以及人们如何希望展现出对客户的尊严和尊重、腾出时间关心同事，你知道的，

sentences.en: not being afraid to use their voice,
sentences.zh: 不怕发出自己的声音，

sentences.en: so long as they're using it in a compassionate way with, you know, they've got a plan where they're going and they can guide people gently by the elbow to get there, you know,
sentences.zh: 只要他们以富有同情心的方式表达，并且，你知道的，他们有一个前行计划，能够轻轻地挽着人们的胳膊引导大家到达目的地，你知道的，

sentences.en: in a way that feels supportive.
sentences.zh: 以一种让人感到被支持的方式。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 完全同意。

sentences.en: And if you think about the role that a psychologist performs, you have got such an important role in somebody's life.
sentences.zh: 如果你想想心理学家所扮演的角色，你在别人的生命中扮演着如此重要的角色。

sentences.en: You are influencing their life.
sentences.zh: 你正在影响他们的生活。

sentences.en: That's a leadership role.
sentences.zh: 这是一个领导角色。

sentences.en: And I loved what you're talking about, the cultural temperature.
sentences.zh: 我非常喜欢你刚才谈到的文化氛围。

sentences.en: If you are going to work within the NHS, remember that all of these NHS trusts up and down the country, they will all have similar but different cultures.
sentences.zh: 如果你要在NHS工作，请记住全国上下所有的这些NHS信托机构，它们的文化既相似又各有不同。

sentences.en: There will be subcultures that exist within an umbrella culture.
sentences.zh: 在大伞式的文化下会存在着各种亚文化。

sentences.en: So work for an organization whose culture aligns with your culture, whose values align with your values, and then you'll feel happier in that workplace.
sentences.zh: 所以，去加入一家文化与你的文化契合、价值观与你的价值观相符的组织，这样你在那个工作场所会感到更快乐。

sentences.en: I've just done a cultural diagnostic on a healthcare provider with 1,400 staff.
sentences.zh: 我刚刚对一家拥有1400名员工的医疗保健提供商做了一个文化诊断。

sentences.en: And there are so many staff who are frustrated, angry, upset, scared about being in that organization because the culture is not right.
sentences.zh: 有那么多的员工感到沮丧、愤怒、心烦意乱、对身处这样一个组织感到恐惧，因为这里的文化不对劲。

sentences.en: So it really is about the values and the culture need to be one.
sentences.zh: 所以这真的很关乎价值观和文化需要合二为一。

sentences.en: They need to be synonymous, but also the values of the organization and the individuals in the organization need to be aligned.
sentences.zh: 它们需要是同义词，而且组织的价值观与组织中个人的价值观也需要保持一致。

sentences.en: So test yourself at that level.
sentences.zh: 所以在那个层面上检验一下你自己。

sentences.en: Next time you go for a job application, don't just look at the banding or the wage or the money that comes from it or the position that you get.
sentences.zh: 下次你去申请工作时，不要只看薪级、工资、带来的金钱回报或你将得到的职位。

sentences.en: Ask yourself, would I be happy working in this organization?
sentences.zh: 问问自己，在这家组织工作我会开心吗？

sentences.en: That is such an important point and a wonderful one to leave it on.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常重要的观点，也是一个绝佳的结束语。

sentences.en: Carl, how can people find out more about you, about your book, about your upcoming book as well?
sentences.zh: 卡尔，人们怎样才能更多地了解你、了解你的书以及你即将出版的新书呢？

sentences.en: Where is the best place for people to connect with you?
sentences.zh: 大家在哪里与你联系最好？

sentences.en: Okay, so the best place, I guess, is either through my website, which is www.igniteyourinnerpotential.com, or just find me on LinkedIn.
sentences.zh: 好的，我想最好的方式要么是通过我的网站，网址是www.igniteyourinnerpotential.com，要么就在领英（LinkedIn）上找到我。

sentences.en: I'm always looking for people to connect with me on LinkedIn.
sentences.zh: 我一直很期待人们在领英上与我联系。

sentences.en: So it's Col Mahay on LinkedIn.
sentences.zh: 所以在领英上搜索Col Mahay。

sentences.en: That's K-U-L.
sentences.zh: 拼写是K-U-L。

sentences.en: And second name is Mahay, M-A-H-A-Y.
sentences.zh: 姓氏是Mahay，M-A-H-A-Y。

sentences.en: Find me on LinkedIn.
sentences.zh: 在领英上找到我。

sentences.en: Connect with me.
sentences.zh: 与我建立联系。

sentences.en: I'm always happy to connect.
sentences.zh: 我总是很高兴能与大家交流。

sentences.en: Perfect.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for your time.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你抽出时间。

sentences.en: It's been a pleasure.
sentences.zh: 这是我的荣幸。

sentences.en: You're so welcome.
sentences.zh: 不用客气。

sentences.en: I've enjoyed it.
sentences.zh: 我也很享受。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Oh, thank you for your time in watching and listening.
sentences.zh: 哦，谢谢你花时间观看和收听。

sentences.en: Isn't Carl just, you know, super inspiring?
sentences.zh: 卡尔是不是，你知道的，超级鼓舞人心？

sentences.en: He's like a little rocket in your pocket that you can keep there for a day where you need a little bit of motivating self-talk,
sentences.zh: 他就象是你口袋里的小火箭，当你在某天需要一点自我激励时，可以随时拿出来用，

sentences.en: which I know that many of you have been in contact to say that this is what I do for you, too.
sentences.zh: 我知道你们中的许多人联系过我，说这也是我对你们所起的作用。

sentences.en: You know, I help you weather the storm of this wild ride in clinical psychology or the route to other qualified psychology routes, too.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我帮助你们度过临床心理学这条狂野旅程中的风雨，或是通往其他合格心理学途径的风雨。

sentences.en: Thank you so much for listening and I will catch you for the next episode of the aspiring psychologist, which will drop in to your favorite podcast supplier at 6 a.m.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你们的收听，我们将在周一早上6点播出的下一期《有志心理学家》（the aspiring psychologist）节目中再见，届时它会登陆你喜爱的各大播客平台。

sentences.en: on Monday.
sentences.zh: 在周一。

sentences.en: Take care, be kind to you and thank you for being in my world.
sentences.zh: 保重，善待自己，谢谢你们走进我的世界。

sentences.en: If you're looking to become a psychologist, then let this be your guide.
sentences.zh: 如果你正期待成为一名心理学家，那就让这成为你的向导。

sentences.en: With this podcast at your side, you'll be on your wish, the aspiring psychologist podcast with Dr. Marianne.
sentences.zh: 有这个播客陪在你身边，你将如愿以偿，欢迎收听由玛丽安博士主持的《有志心理学家播客》。

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你不仅靠出卖时间换取金钱，还能赚到钱，会怎么样呢？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家玛丽安·特伦特博士，自2019年以来，我一直在开发被动收入和循环收入流。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有个好消息要宣布。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One to Many program is now open for enrollment.
sentences.zh: 苏菲·富特的“一对多”项目（One to Many）现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可规模化的产品，比如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the program myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys, too.
sentences.zh: 我在2022年自己完成了这个项目，此后也一直支持两期心理学家学员走过他们的蜕变之旅。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的专属联盟链接加入，你将获得苏菲的额外福利以及我提供的专属支持套餐，无需支付额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalized guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的WhatsApp支持、四场大师班指导、大师课、个性化指导、一份福南梅森（Fortnum and Mason）礼品以及限时一对一教练指导福利。

sentences.en: Enrollment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10 p.m.
sentences.zh: 报名将于11月16日（星期一）晚上10点截止。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过简介中链接的我的福利页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的福利。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时都在。
